_comment: HARDENED 2026-09-06: this file is a deliberate copy in each of the three apps, and an attempt to share it was made and REVERTED — record it here so it is not attempted a third time. Both `"extends": "@smarthire/config/jsconfig"` and the relative `"extends": "../../packages/config/jsconfig.base.json"` build clean-looking configs that Turbopack does not read: it does not follow `extends` in a jsconfig at all, so the @/* alias simply vanishes and every aliased import fails with `Module not found`, 45 of them in marketing alone. The eslint config IS shared, because that one is real JavaScript that the linter imports. This one has to stay literal.
